Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? Anime Overview:

Following his demise from a vehicular accident while protecting a child, a self-sacrificing corporate employee wakes up in a fantasy realm. Instead of assuming the form of a heroic adventurer or a powerful noble, his soul inhabits a goblin, a monster race typically characterized by extreme weakness and a severely limited natural lifespan. Utilizing unique abilities that transcend ordinary biological constraints, he begins navigating the dangers of a hostile environment to survive. This unexpected reincarnation launches an uphill struggle against the natural hierarchy of the new world, setting the foundation for his rise from the bottom of the food chain.

Japanese Title: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？

images.alt:
Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu. Anime Overview:

Rose lives a quiet, solitary existence near a scenic body of water, earning a reputation among locals as a capable herbalist and magic user. Her peaceful routine takes an unexpected turn when a handsome knight named Harij arrives at her dwelling with an unusual request. Smitten with the warrior for quite some time, Rose is devastated to discover that he is asking her to brew an elixir designed to make someone else fall in love with him. Despite her inner turmoil, she agrees to assist him in collecting the necessary rare materials. This arrangement forces the reclusive magic user into frequent contact with the object of her affection, sparking an awkward yet heartwarming professional relationship. As the pair venture out together to gather components for the concoction, Harij begins exhibiting attentive behaviors that complicate Rose's emotional state. The series explores their evolving dynamic as a slow-burning romantic comedy set in a fantasy world filled with magical flora, mythical creatures, and gentle miscommunications between an unsuspecting knight and a hopelessly smitten spellcaster.

Japanese Title: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。

Official Site: https://horemajo-anime.com/
